steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I still think something about this doesn't add up.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios! Is this really the time for that? Who knows when that orc will catch up to us?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't you have even a little sense of danger? This is uncharted territory! Nothing we know about the dungeon is going to help us here!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I didn't expect the slugs to have totally different habits and levels of aggressiveness just for having different shells.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But why were they working with that creature as strong as an orc? Are the slugs really intelligent enough to be tamed?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Shh—Pipe down. The orc is here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Quietly) H-He's coming!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Quietly) What the—! Why is he attacking the slugs? Are they not on the same side?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Quietly) Is he attacking everything around him indiscriminately?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hold on... I have an idea.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What are you up to this time?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hi.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I've had enough of this! If we're doing this, let's do it now!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Marcille, wait!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm not going to get myself killed here by some orc! Falin is still waiting for me to save her!

steps.name: Scary Orc?
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Scary Orc?
steps.text: Kill...? Why would I kill you?!

steps.name: Scary Orc?
steps.text: Do I look that scary?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Cut the crap!

steps.name: Scary Orc?
steps.text: Hey, watch out—

steps.name: Scary Orc
steps.text: And that's the last of them. It's always a pain when they start running around all over the place.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I knew it. You're not a violent brute who attacks indiscriminately... You just wanted to take care of the slugs for us!

steps.name: Not-So-Scary Orc
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Not-So-Scary Orc
steps.text: Hahaha, it's your first time here. No wonder.

steps.name: Not-So-Scary Orc
steps.text: You see, I own this little ranch here, and I built these huts with my friends. Took us a whole lot of work just to keep the Originium slugs under control.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You can call me Big Bob. You look like a bunch of wandering vagrants. The wastes are a dangerous place. You ought to rest up here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Excuse me, vagrants?! We're adventurers.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Is there a difference?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Of course there is!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: So they're called Originium slugs...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You're kidding me. You've never heard of Originium slugs?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, we haven't introduced ourselves yet, have we? I'm Laios. This is Senshi, the newest member of the party. And this is Marcille, a mage, and this is Chilchuck the locksmith.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Now that I take a look, you're all dressed kinda funny. Are you actors from Wrankwood?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Never mind... Bet you wouldn't get it even if I explained.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Anyway, most folks would know to stay away when they see so many slugs in one place. So why'd you come anyway? They thought you were intruders.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So you raise these slugs here! That's incredible.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Heh, this is nothing. There are plenty of those little guys here. Rather than making enemies of 'em out in the wastes, I figured I'd try putting them to use.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: They always get more active this time of year. That's why I came out to the hut. Didn't expect to find you folks waking all of them up and leading them away though.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Seems like I'll have to knock 'em all out one by one and drag 'em back in.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Uh, sorry about that...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Haha, it's okay!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So anyway... you mean they're edible?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?! Are you crazy?! Do I have to remind you that they were trying to kill us just now?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: And this isn't the time to learn about local cuisines! We need to—

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: We do eat Originium slugs, though.

steps.name: Laios & Senshi
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: They don't exactly seem domesticated...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Do they have some kind of unique flavor then?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Not quite. Rather than flavor, it's more like... eh, you should try 'em out yourselves! I'll whip up something for you.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I can help.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What???

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eat what? These slugs? No! No, no! Hell no!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I've cleaned the pot, Bob. I'd love to see how you cook the slugs.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Great, thanks! First things first: the slugs we just caught can't be eaten right away. Gotta flip 'em over and keep them in water for five days to starve them. Keeps their digestive tracts clean.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What? You're saying we need to wait five days for this?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Ha, you'd starve first. Luckily I already prepared some earlier. Make sure you wear gloves. We'll boil them in water. That'll shrink the meat and make 'em easier to shell.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why can't you just pry it off as is?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Because this way we can clean out all the mucus inside.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Just blanch them in the boiling water briefly and take them out. After that, we'll take the shell off and give the meat a rinse. See the mucus?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh... Just like slimes...

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What? You haven't heard of slimes?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Slimes! Like, the super common monster on the upper levels of the dungeon.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: So once you remove the meat, you keep heating the shells in the water.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hey! Don't just ignore me!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: As for the meat, there's still lots of mucus right now. We'll squeeze some lemons on it, then rub it hard with salt and flour to get all the mucus off.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Remove all the organs... Take off this membrane... And rinse it a total of five times.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So we can't eat the organs or the membrane? I mean, slimes taste so good when eaten whole.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Feel free to give it a try, if you don't feel like waking up to see the sun tomorrow.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Now you finally put down the slug guts, huh?

spans.text: you finally put down the slug guts, huh?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Such a delicate cleaning process... Even I am not familiar with many ingredients that need to be prepared like this.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: They're Originium slugs. That makes 'em far more dangerous than most animals out there. There's no skipping this step.

spans.text: slugs. That makes 'em far more dangerous than most animals out there. There's no skipping this step.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: The ones I breed on my ranch may be raised in a controlled environment, but even they need to have their innards cleaned.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: If you run into any wild ones, don't even try to cook 'em. You could wash those slugs dozens of times and they still wouldn't be safe to eat.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Looks like a huge pain. Can we pick up the pace, please?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: No. Ingredients like these need to be handled carefully.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: After this step, we'll add some aromatic herbs to the water, like those thorny branches and leaves over there, and boil the slug in it again.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: More boiling?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: What's the rush, long ears? That's how you get rid of the earthy scent and tenderize the meat.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: If you don't mind the smell, though, we can skip the aromatics.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Er, please continue.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Let's add as many chilis as we can. It'll be so spicy you'll feel like you can breathe fire. And then, more firewood. Keep those flames high!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: After that, we're pretty much done. We slice the meat, fry up a few more side ingredients, mix 'em up and start stir-frying. As soon as the meat starts to curl, it's done. Any longer, and it'll be too dry.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Remember, as soon as the meat starts to curl.

spans.text: Remember, as soon as the meat

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Whoops. Skipped a step. We should've drizzled some Originium slug beer onto the meat...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No need for that! This is more than perfect as it is!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Let's just dig in already! Then we can get back on the road! No need to waste more time on any extra steps!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: ...If you say so. Not my problem.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Well then, the Stir-fried Chili Originium Slug is done!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Hey, Big Beard, what're you doing?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let me try something.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: These shells have been cleaned, right?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What is he up to?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: We'll put the cleaned slug meat back into the shells, mince some garlic and add a little butter, salt, and pepper... And of course don't forget the missing step: drizzle the meat in some Originium slug beer.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Then, add a bit of minced garlic at the shells' openings...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And finally, put the shells back in the fire facing upwards and roast them for a while.
The flames lick the Originium slug shells and give out an intense wheat aroma.
The oil sizzles as the warm scent of the garlic wafts toward the party.
Then, there is a light, joyful sound—
*crackle*

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: There we go! Now hurry and take them out.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I've got pancakes ready, too! Come on, let's eat!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Delicious!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Put the meat on the bread, and bite into it with the chilis. Then, take a sip of beer. Try it!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Here, try the pancakes! I added some fowlbeast eggs. You'll love it, guaranteed.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Is that colorful stuff on top crushed candies? It's sweet!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Fine, I'll try it too!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Originium slug antennae.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wow! So good! I like the chewy texture... but way too spicy! It's very different from Senshi's cooking, but still good!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hm... With the beer, the roast slug doesn't have that earthy taste at all, unlike the stir fry.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I knew it. The result is always better when you don't cut corners. Rushing will do you no good.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: No matter how minor a step is, we must take it carefully. That's what's so fascinating about cooking. Marcille, how anxious you were made me realize this.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hey, I wasn't!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm not the kind of person who throws caution to the wind when I'm anxious! I'm only so worried because none of you seem to be!

spans.text: I'm not the kind of person who throws caution to the wind when I'm anxious! I'm only so worried because none of

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's like none of you even want to get back as soon as possible...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: This beer is awesome! It's got a different malty taste to it, unlike anything I've ever had!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Well, that's good to hear. I was planning to bottle and sell it, so I brewed a couple batches. Sounds like I'll be raking in the dough.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Originium slug beer? Is it brewed with the slugs? How does that work?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: There are many ways. If you raise them in clean wheat husks from the moment they're born, the husks will stick to them, and eventually they'll form shells that keep the smell.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: And if you mix those shells into your brew's hops, this beer is what you'll get.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: A few other places do it differently. Say, feeding the slugs hops and using their mucus in the brew.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I'm sure it'd taste different, but I like my brews the best!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: The same goes for the pancakes you just had. Give those shiny little fellas some fruit, and their shells will end up sweet.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Mmh... *burp*.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I guess I can relax now that I know there's a market for my beer.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: All of this is so good...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Anyway, I think Marcille's been so anxious because... we kind of stumbled our way into this place by accident.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: To be frank, most of what you guys have said has gone right over my head.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *sigh*... Never mind. I guess we'll have to look elsewhere for answers.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Well, everyone gets homesick. I know that much at least.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: But I've never met anyone who knows as little as you guys. It's not safe, traveling like that... Take these with you.
Big Bob quickly packs up some prepared slug meat and beer and hands them over to Laios, along with a book.
Laios flips through the book and finds it filled with crooked, illegible letters.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Heh, that's my 'Bob's Gourmet Guide.' I wrote down everything I've seen and whether it's edible or not.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Take it. You seem surprised by even the littlest things, so just follow what it says in the book. Don't starve or get yourselves food poisoning.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Seems like this is right up Laios's alley.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I can picture the expression on his face without even looking.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Oh, right, I also know of this place that has... uh, a lot of eccentric people. I'm sure they'd be able to help you get home.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I mean, they even got that red-eyed woman on a leash. If anyone can handle this, it's them.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Really? What's that place called?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: They've been opening branch offices in even the most remote villages. You should be able to find them pretty easily.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Okay. Rhodes Island. Got it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: (Quietly) ...What a strange name for an island.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Quietly) Does that mean we'll need to board a ship...?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: If you do manage to find it, remember to say hello to Mudrock for me.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Not a problem.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Alright then. I hope you'll find them soon!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Thanks, big guy.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: What an interesting bunch.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I sure hope they'll find that... dungeon soon.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Ahem, now back to work!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Hm? What happened to the rest of the food?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Did they finish all of it...? Hm...
*burp*
Cooked Originium slug... yummy!
